title: A Contact for the Protocol
author: Lena Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Thackeray, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
